description: Search saved-profile aggregate counts for public and listed MEKU humans marked online, requiring every requested skill on the same human. Only the first 500 saved profiles are checked; counts_complete=false means partial counts, not a complete total. Countries list only profiles matching the requested skills and location. Location filters use exact trim/case-normalized self-reported data, not verified live location or promised availability. Empty skills adds no skill filter. Exact-filter zero does not prove nobody is available. Never returns names, profiles or contact details.

region.description: Optional exact saved-profile region filter; missing or blank stored regions do not match.

skills.description: Optional skills: all must match on the same human, case-insensitively (max 10); empty means no skill filter.

name: meku_search_humans
title: Search available human capabilities
